### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the swap": excluded by the active-status sentence and status `tow_noticed`.
- "Catch-up payment of the balance instead of redemption": excluded by tow_redemption_payment ("only a payment of the full redemption amount … is accepted") and gate_lockout_and_tow_process item 5 + collections timetable ("Payment below the balance after the notice of intent to tow: Not accepted").
- "Redeem 230.00 without posting the fee": excluded by the redemption-amount sentence.
- Late-fee or billing-error prerequisites on this agreement: every unpaid-past-grace period carries a late fee; the only on-time period (Aug) carries none; nothing to correct.
- Compliance: insurance on file not yet expired (11-20) — no compliance notice due; registration renewal path not relevant (different vehicle).
- Fall-backs (computation documents only): 40.00 vs 57.75; 287.75 vs 452.75; 15.00 vs 25.25 — all definite and different. Factor documents reached from record words: "notice of intent to tow" (repeat-notice level, re-verification, dispatch hold), AutoPay "suspended"/"declined for an expired card" (autopay relief, redemption advance), rent charges vs payments counts (unpaid-period multiplier, tenure relief, good-record reduction), late fee count (redemption deposit), period end / next due (billing-period timing, next-rent collection), insurance expiry on file (document check), swap fee history (swap fee level), tenure (swap tenure multiplier). None of the three computation documents hints at a variation.
